name: 4x4 Matrix Keypad
tagline: 16-button alphanumeric input matrix using multiplexed row/column scanning
description: The 4x4 Matrix Keypad provides 16 momentary buttons organized in 4 rows and 4 columns (digits 0-9, *, #, and letters A-D). By multiplexing rows and columns, it uses only 8 GPIO pins on a microcontroller instead of 16 individual lines.

pinout.name: Row Pins
pinout.desc: Rows 1 through 4 connected to digital I/O

pinout.name: Column Pins
pinout.desc: Columns 1 through 4 connected to digital I/O

wiringNote: Use the Arduino Keypad library which handles debouncing and row-column scanning automatically.
commonMistakes: Wiring row and column pins in reverse order
Using pins 0 and 1 (UART TX/RX) for keypad lines
